scenes.line: One house, seven ways to run it. The old way, that's seven spreadsheets.
Look up furnished rents, Airbnb occupancy, hud limits for Section 8, the refi math for a BRRRR, and rehab costs for a flip.
And you still don't know which one wins, or if Airbnb is even allowed.
Long-term, mid-term, Airbnb, Section 8, house hack, BRRRR and flip, side by side.
The best play is called out for you,
and every number is yours to change. Know your strategy before you offer.

extra_lines.paste: DealCaddie runs all seven at once. Just paste the listing.

why: Most investors only run one strategy. The best deal might be hiding in another.
